# One step that checks your workflows for twelve known risks

> Add one free GitHub Action to scan your workflows for script injection, pwn requests, cache and artifact poisoning, leaked secrets, over-broad permissions and more. Read-only, zero dependencies, SARIF and step-summary output, no network calls.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
